description: MCP Server for Raindrop.io bookmark management
author: Adam E

tool_signatures.name: bookmark_manage
tool_signatures.description: Creates, updates, or deletes bookmarks. Use the operation parameter to specify the action.

tool_signatures.name: bookmark_search
tool_signatures.description: Searches bookmarks with advanced filters, tags, and full-text search.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_edit_raindrops
tool_signatures.description: Bulk update, move, or remove bookmarks in a specific collection.

tool_signatures.description: Remove all collections that do not contain any bookmarks. Requires

tool_signatures.name: collection_list
tool_signatures.description: Lists all Raindrop.io collections as a flat list.

tool_signatures.name: collection_manage
tool_signatures.description: Creates, updates, or deletes a collection. Use the operation parameter to specify the action.

tool_signatures.name: empty_trash
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete all bookmarks currently in the trash collection. Requires

tool_signatures.description: Returns a hierarchical view of all collections with full breadcrumb paths.

tool_signatures.name: get_raindrop
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single Raindrop.io bookmark by ID.

tool_signatures.name: library_audit
tool_signatures.description: Scans the entire library for broken links and duplicate bookmarks.

tool_signatures.name: list_raindrops
